analysis.investment_thesis: Paradeep Parivahan exhibits a superficially attractive P/E of 6.53 and strong 65.96% promoter holding, but a ROE of just 0.26% indicates negligible earning power on the employed capital base — a fatal flaw by my standards. Combined with its recent listing status (no multi-year audited public track record) and concentrated port-dependency, this fails my margin-of-safety test.
key_strengths: Low headline P/E of 6.53 — below my 15x ceiling
Asset-based logistics business tied to a real physical port (tangible operations)
key_risks: ROE of 0.26% signals virtually no return on equity — earning power is illusory
Recently listed — lacks the 5+ year earnings record I require
red_flags: ROE of 0.26% is incompatible with a genuinely profitable enterprise
Likely post-IPO equity dilution inflated book value and crushed returns
No disclosed dividend history, current ratio, or debt-to-equity — insufficient quantitative data to verify safety
analysis.detailed_analysis:
From a Graham perspective, the single most damning number here is ROE of 0.26%. Even if the P/E of 6.53 looks cheap, a business earning a quarter of a percent on shareholders' equity is essentially not compounding capital — it is dormant money. This usually happens when an IPO dumps fresh cash onto the balance sheet faster than the business can deploy it, or when reported "earnings" are not representative. Either way, I cannot call this "proven earning power." The market cap of INR 231 Cr on such thin profitability offers no demonstrable margin of safety against operational setbacks at Paradip Port.

The qualitative story — port logistics, stevedoring, railway siding — is a legitimate tangible-asset business, and 65.96% promoter holding is reassuring. But I do not buy stories; I buy verified financial records at a discount to intrinsic value. Without multi-year audited earnings, current ratio, debt-to-equity, interest coverage, and dividend history, I have no ability to compute a Graham Number or confirm balance-sheet resilience. Mr. Market is offering a newly listed security where the seller (promoter/banker) knew more than the buyer at issuance. Pass until a 3-5 year earnings track record materializes and ROE normalizes above 10%.
